column2: the proposed prompt-side elision keys only on mental `brainstorm_requested` from step 0-pre, but `_step1d5_entry_main` uses `_step1d5_brainstorm_requested`, which reads `$design_tmpdir/run-params.json`. on `resume@*` paths, step 0b sub-step 5 flag binding is skipped, so mental argv binding can stay false while persisted `brainstorm_requested: true` remains (`_merge_router_flags` ors true in but does not clear a prior true). after `resume@1c` or `resume@1d`, prompt-side elision would skip the entry fence and jump to step 1d.7, silently dropping brainstorm-on behavior that today's entry fence would still run.

when brainstorm-off elision removes the `step1d5 --mode entry` fence, the run loses that fence's `pause_ok=true` terminal stop handling. the step 1d.5 section is today the only step 1d.5 prose with explicit `pause_ok=true` stop semantics. although `step1d7_main` calls `check_pause_and_exit`, skill.md tells the orchestrator to bind `skip_approve_requested` from the fence output and continue into outline work without a matching `pause_ok=true` stop contract at step 1d.7. a pause at `step1d7` could save state while the orchestrator still proceeds into outline work.

python/larch/design/design_lifecycle.py:3041-3055 [scope-reduction] step1d7_main plans unconditional step-1c/1d/1d.5 writes before pause-check. scenario: on brainstorm-on runs, step1d5 entry leaves step-1d.5 absent until --mode complete. if step1d7 ever runs early (resume drift, orchestrator bug, or direct cli), a premature step-1d.5 makes design_pause._determine_step advance to 1d.7 and skip unfinished brainstorm work. today step1d7 writes no sentinels, so missing step-1d.5 still routes resume to 1d.5.

python/larch/design/design_lifecycle.py:3041-3055 [scope-reduction] plan has step1d7_main write step-1c/step-1d/step-1d.5 unconditionally before every pause check; gate on brainstorm off only. scenario: on brainstorm-on runs entry/complete already own those sentinels; unconditional step-1d.5 here also masks a missing complete fence by marking 1d.5 done and letting pause/resume jump to 1d.7 with brainstorm unfinished. matches step2a which only touches step-1d.5 when brainstorm_requested is false.

planned `step1d7` tests only pin sentinel writes on the pause branch. elision moves brainstorm-off `step-1c`/`step-1d`/`step-1d.5` writes from `_step1d5_entry_main` to `step1d7_main` for every brainstorm-off reach of step 1d.7, not only when `.pause-requested` exists. `test_step1d5_entry_disabled_skip_writes_completion_and_directives` already covers the no-pause happy path for entry; the planned `test_step1d7_brainstorm_off_pause_writes_sentinels_before_pause` only exercises `.pause-requested` and would still pass if `step1d7_main` gates sentinel writes on that file. a later pause during outline or step 2b would leave `step-1c` absent and `_determine_step` would resume at `1c`, replaying completed discussion.
